subject: Penetration test artifacts and segmentation acceptance criteria for MegaFin Dedicated VPC
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@megafin.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@megafin.com
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: penetration test report + segmentation evidence for Dedicated VPC

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As part of MegaFin's vendor security review for the Dedicated VPC deployment, our InfoSec team needs the following artifacts to complete our SIG/SOC2 evidence bundle: 

- Final penetration test report (redacted as needed) that covers the Dedicated VPC/private deployment boundary and includes test dates and scope.
- Network segmentation diagram showing tenant boundary, egress controls, and any shared services in the customer-managed VPC.
- A short mapping (1 page) that explains the boundary assumptions your redteam used for the engagement (what is in-scope vs out-of-scope for customer VPCs).
- Current remediation status for any high/critical findings with timestamps and owner.

Can you confirm when you can ship these? We aim to close the security review by 2025-12-05. If there are parts you cannot disclose, please provide an evidence package and a suggested acceptance checklist we can use for SOC 2 control mapping.

Appreciate a response by EOD Monday PST.

Best,
Alice
Alice Jenkins
Senior Security Analyst, MegaFin Bank
alice.jenkins@megafin.com

--
Attachment: (n/a at initial request)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@megafin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report + segmentation evidence for Dedicated VPC

Hi Alice,

Thanks — we can provide a sanitized evidence bundle that meets your SOC 2 and SIG needs. Quick summary of what we'll deliver and timing: 

1) redwood-megafin-pt-summary.pdf (sanitized pen test report) — will include scope statement, test dates (Nov 10–14, 2025), threat model summary, and a redacted findings appendix. ETA: 2025-12-01 EOD.

2) network-segmentation-diagram.png — customer VPC architecture with annotated tenant boundary and egress paths. ETA: 2025-11-30 EOD.

3) boundary-assumptions-1p.txt (inline explanation) — 1 page mapping of what our redteam considered in-scope for private deployments vs responsibilities of the customer-managed VPC (eg, customer-controlled BGP/peering, managed NAT, etc.). Will include explicit callouts where evidence cannot be produced because it is under customer control. ETA: 2025-11-30.

4) remediation-log-2025-11-30.csv — list of remediations for High/Critical issues found in the engagement, owners, and verification date. We will flag any findings that require customer action. ETA: 2025-11-30.

If acceptable, we'll upload the bundle to a secured Drive link and provide a short acceptance checklist you can use to map to SIG/SOC 2 criteria (control references included).

A couple of clarifications we need from you to ensure scope alignment: 
- Please confirm whether MegaFin considers cloud-level routing (route tables and transit gateway configs) under your control or wants Redwood to demonstrate the absence of exploitable misconfigurations for the Hosted side of the deployment.
- Are you accepting redacted host-level logs for any customer-controlled machines, or do you require full host-level artifacts for SOC mapping?

I'll loop in Marcus and Neha for remediation verification and evidence packaging.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance Solutions, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0137

--
Attachment: (none yet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report + segmentation evidence for Dedicated VPC

Priya / Neha,

Quick status update from remediation track: 
- Critical finding C-01 (plaintext config exposure) — fixed and verified on 2025-11-29 by infra; verification notes added to remediation-log-2025-11-30.csv.
- High finding H-07 (egress ACL weakness) — mitigation in place (NAC and deny-by-default ACLs) and testproofs captured; customer-controlled egress path still needs confirmation from MegaFin if they manage a shared transit gateway.
- Medium/Low items: scheduled for next sprint, no blocker for evidence delivery.

I will export the sanitized report and the diagram and put them behind a restricted Drive folder with view/download audit. Priya — please include a brief acceptance checklist showing which artifacts are sufficient for SOC 2 mapping and which require customer attestation.

Marcus
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

--
Attachment: remediation-log-2025-11-30.csv

From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@megafin.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 07:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report + segmentation evidence for Dedicated VPC

Thanks — that works. Two follow-ups before you send the bundle: 
1) For routing/transit gateway: MegaFin manages the transit gateway and route tables. We'll provide a signed attestation that the routing configuration is customer-managed, but we do want Redwood to include a short statement in the report acknowledging that as an out-of-scope responsibility and listing what evidence you relied on for the in-scope network controls.

2) Host-level artifacts: we accept redacted host logs where necessary for PII/sensitive content, but we will need the timestamped verification artifacts for any remediated High/Critical items (screenshots or testproof snippets).

Can you include both items in the final upload? If yes, we'll plan a 60-minute review on 2025-12-04 to validate items with our SOC team.

Regards,
Alice

--
Attachment: (none)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@megafin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report + segmentation evidence for Dedicated VPC

Alice,

Confirmed — we will: 
- Add an explicit 'Out-of-scope: customer-managed routing' subsection to the pen test summary that lists the evidence we reviewed (customer attestation, VPC peering config screenshot, and transit gateway route table snapshot) and states that configuration ownership remains with MegaFin.
- Include timestamped verification artifacts (redacted screenshots and curl/proof snippets) for the remediated High/Critical items in the restricted Drive folder.
- Upload the files to https://redwood.drive/g/megafin-pt-evidence by 2025-12-02 17:00 PST and send you a DocuSign-style access log if you need an audit trail.

Acceptance checklist (short):
- Pen test summary (scope + redacted findings) — OK for SOC mapping
- Network segmentation diagram — verifies tenant isolation and egress controls
- Remediation log with verification artifacts — required for closure of High/Critical
- Customer routing attestation — required to mark routing-related controls out-of-scope

Let us know preferred time on 2025-12-04 for the 60-minute review and we will send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Priya

--
Attachments: redwood-megafin-pt-summary.pdf (sanitized), network-segmentation-diagram.png, remediation-log-2025-11-30.csv
